python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Locate sections by first column labels
rows = df[0].astype(str).str.strip()
start = rows[rows == 'EXPENSES'].index[0] + 1
end = rows[rows == 'Total Expenses'].index[0]
exp = df.iloc[start:end]
exp.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount']
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'], errors='coerce')
by_cat = exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum()
print('Expense rows:'); print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print(); print('By category:'); print(by_cat.to_string())
print(); print('GRAND TOTAL EXPENSES =', by_cat.sum())
"
